summary.label: Hurricane Isaias period weather at Tompkins Hall (actual Open-Meteo archive)

weather_source.note: Isaias tracked offshore FL/GA then NC landfall; Tuskegee saw outer-band cloud/light precip in archive. Solar AC derived from observed shortwave radiation at this point.

assumptions: Weather/solar irradiance from Open-Meteo historical archive at install point 32.42898750800647, -85.70454560185496.
Solar AC kW = 7.83 * (GHI_W/m2 / 1000), calibrated to Tompkins 16 kW array peak AC.
Battery/load shedding modeled for demo parity with cloudy-night package; labeled Simulated.
Hurricane Isaias did not make landfall in Alabama; series uses actual local conditions during the storm period.
